notes.title: World Ship Simulator Has Launched
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

World Ship Simulator has launched in Early Access

We are still very hard at work in development with a new development team and are going to be doing our very best to bring you a great game. As this is Early Access, there will be some features not yet fully realised and some parts that may seem buggy. We’d appreciate reporting issues in the Steam forums.

For suggestions, general feedback and discussions please visit the main forum page.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/403980/discussions/

For reporting bugs, please visit the Bugs forum

http://steamcommunity.com/app/403980/discussions/1/

The first month of development will be on the following key areas
[list][*]Improving bridge interior quality (none of the current ships are up to final interior quality)
[*]Balancing in game economy and ranking
[*]Creating new missions for Career Mode
[*]Gaining community feedback from users to plan following months work load
[*]Adjusting English text & translating into other languages[/list]

New ships will of course be added in Early Access but we would like to refine what we have first before we begin to add new content. 

As for new ships, we would like your requests. Check out the link below to find details on how you can suggest new ships and the process we are adopting.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/403980/discussions/0/496881136922726077/

We will be building up suggestions for the very first few weeks and implementing as many as possible.

We also have a Fishing boat which can be unlocked by registering your game, Registering allows us to contact you for specific updates for World Ship Simulator including detailing any important decisions that may be made with the community. Check the link for more details:

http://www.excalibur-publishing.com/pages/world-ship-simulator-registration

And finally, just to note that Players who have purchased European Ship Simulator up until 24th of November will receive World Ship Simulator for free.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: An Important Anouncement - The Future
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We would like to share some news with you regarding the development of European Ship Simulator. We would like to let everyone know why we have been pretty quiet over the past few months. 

During the Early Access period of European Ship Simulator, negotiations with the developer had broken down and this meant we were unable to support the game further. This resulted in a hunt to locate a new development team to take over the rest of the development process. We should have communicated this earlier, though when we started the search for a new development team to take over, we were expecting the turnaround for the new developer to take over the project to be much shorter.

However upon receiving the source code, the new developer had asked us if they could start the project again so that they can implement new features much more effectively without the restrictions of using the previous code. 

So, the game evolved and became its own game, using perhaps some existing models (though retextured to increase performance) and using the same water engine. The game has been for the last month been titled “World Ship Simulator” and will release during Early Access at a similar stage of playability that European Ship Simulator had become.

While we have spent time and resources to develop a new game with a new developer, we do feel we should have communicated more effectively what was happening behind the scenes of European Ship Simulator. For that reason we have the following in place.

Anyone who has purchased European Ship Simulator up to the release of World Ship Simulator, will be given World Ship Simulator for free. 

World Ship Simulator will differ in quite a few ways and below are just a few bullet points to list what we will have when it launches

•	Open world map with no loading screens between ports
•	Initially three fictional ports (with busier ports)
•	Career mode where players start with a ship, earn money, gain experience and purchase new ships
•	Ship Crew added
•	New day/night sky effects
•	Ability to speed up time in game
•	Damage system with visible damage that dents the sides of ships
•	Currently working on developing a hovercraft to use in the game
•	Ability to leave the vessel and accept missions off shore


We'd also like to share a few screenshots of World Ship Simulator (two of these vessels you may remember from European Ship Simulator)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aIDBO1r.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NO7A7XC.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eZ8bVC7.jpg[/img]

While currently we are using the same water system we used for European Ship Simulator, we are also keeping an eye on a new water system that we may use for the game once it releases

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nHudbVe5QbA

So in summary, World Ship Simulator is to launch later this year in Early Access and everyone who owns European Ship Simulator will be given this for free. We really do want to expand the Ship Simulator genre and we hope you will join us as we progress further with this.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - Port Boat And Future Development
notes.notes:
Today, I’d like to share with you our future plans for European Ship Simulator. We are restructuring our development team so that we are able to dedicate more time and resources to turn this into the core product that we have envisioned. 

We have every intention of supporting this for many years to come and in the next few months we will have more news to share on the future of European Ship Simulator along with plans for new features, refinements and implementing suggestions from the community.

To kick-start this, we are releasing a variety of new missions over the next 8 weeks, starting with the new port boat and one new mission available from today.We hope to reveal news of further development within the next one to two months with detailed plans regarding how we are going to improve and refine this game.

Please follow us on our social media channels and check the steam forums for more news coming shortly.

notes.title: The Future Of European Ship Simulator
notes.notes:
First, I’d like to thank everyone who has been involved with the game and I would like to quell some fears that our departure from Early Access means we have stopped supporting the game. Right now, the game is complete, in a state that the game works, you have twenty missions, you have several ships and you can complete these missions. 

When claims over the game being “unfinished” arise, I can imagine that you are expecting more content than has been delivered. In response, I can confirm that the game will continue to evolve. The core game is complete. But what comes next is the evolution.

As I’ve stated before, the full release is what we deem a stage where the game is complete enough to release for a second platform (MAC) and to make the mission editor public, I have no intention of stopping work on this game in the near future.

I will be populating a new development board with features that the community can vote for, alongside information on what is currently being developed. Expect this to go live in a few days.

The term Early Access can mean that a project can be in development indefinitely. For us, we are approaching it as a living game where the base game is complete, but we want to evolve for the foreseeable future.

We are starting out small. We have to, as it is impossible for us to reach some of the heights set by other games at this moment in time. This is the foundation of which we can build and improve upon, a comment I have made several times in the forums months and months before releasing as a full release. It’s now our job to prove that we are determined to make this the go to ship simulator. 

We are currently working on three major updates that will include among other things, three new ports and three new vessels. I anticipate that by late next week I will share more details on the development.

notes.title: European Ship Simulator Full Release
notes.notes:
Today’s launch signifies the first major milestone of European Ship Simulator.

Launching as a full game we have included 20 missions, a mission editor and now MAC support. We have to thank everyone who has been involved during the Early Access period and while the game enters a full release, we still intend to support the game post launch with new ships, ports, refinements and will be looking into some of the majorly requested features over the coming months. I’ll be able to share further news of European Ship Simulator in the coming weeks so do stay tuned.
 
The big content update is the bay of Gibraltar, a particularly massive map with several ports. There are three missions in this port but of course you can create your own and play others with the mission editor (more info below)
 
But right now, the game is now available in 8 languages including
 
English
German
Dutch
Spanish
French
Italian
Greek
Polish
 
Mac users will also be able to get involved in European Ship Simulator too, if you have bought the game previously for PC and have a MAC too, you will be able to play on mac without needing to purchase again.
 
We are also launching the mission editor today and have created a very in depth guide with instructions on how to create your own missions. It is very technical and we are going to put together a video tutorial soon that may make it easier to follow. But find the first part of our guide here:

[url]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=393689034[/url]
 
Finally, as a special surprise, we have created an extra ship, a medium cruiser with a couple of extra missions.  Here’s a screenshot of the bridge
 
[img]https://scontent-lhr.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfp1/t31.0-8/10989232_756869711065036_6666683656485478766_o.jpg[/img]
 
You can get this ship for free right now by visiting [url]www.euroshipsim.com[/url] and following the links to claim a medium cruiser, you’ll get a special code and you’ll enter into the code area of the options menu.
 
During Early Access we made contact with several officials including nautical universities, navigational officers, captains and more. We are going to be following up with these over the coming months to investigate further improvements to European Ship Simulator.
We’ll be in the forums to answer questions and will be revealing more information about the future of European Ship Simulator soon.

notes.title: European Ship Simulator leaves Early Access Feb 20th 2015
notes.notes:
Good day everyone,

European Ship Simulator will be leaving Early Access on the 20th of February 2015. I’d like to thank many of you for getting involved in helping us with the development. Since the game launched in Early Access we have compiled a massive list of suggestions, have made contact with navigational officers and several maritime universities. We have also received dozens of positive reviews from the community.

On February 20th the game will launch into a full release with the following content:

20 Missions
Eight ships
Six ports
Mission Editor
MAC version
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Greek, Dutch Languages

As I’ve said previously in the forums, this is a foundation from which we can build upon and something that I would like to improve over the coming months, maybe years. While the full release definition is the state at which the game will be available as a boxed product in retail stores, my goal is to work on the ship simulator genre for the foreseeable future.  We have made some great contacts and it’s now our responsibility to use these and evolve.

Thanks again for being a part of European Ship Simulator.

All the best,
Chris

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - CRUISE LINER AND MORE
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-b-lhr.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xap1/t31.0-8/10914957_744317915653549_8437944235914784485_o.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

Today we have a particularly large update for European Ship Simulator.

First, the large cruise liner will be under your command. Alongside this great vessel will be the port of Hamburg, It does feature a very large industrial area and in the coming weeks expect to see more missions on this new map. It is possibly one of the most populated maps in terms of buildings.

Among these big noticeable updates we have included a few more additions. Water reflections have been altered so that they are not as severely reflective as previously. A save and continue feature has been added for those of you who want to tackle the entire lengthy trip across the English channel but need to turn of the game and wish to continue where you left off.

Finally, we also have added the cinematic camera mode. You can take some great screenshots with this mode, below is a screenshot from the new mode, we’ve just cut off the HUD![img]https://scontent-b-lhr.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfp1/t31.0-8/1932584_744341182317889_665026427601480895_o.jpg[/img]

We know it’s been some time since we updated but I hope that you all enjoy this latest update. Please visit the forums to get in touch with us with any suggestions, thoughts or if you happen to come across any issues.

For a quick glimpse at what the new update has to offer, watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fu-bmjRRbNo

notes.title: UPDATES COMING SOON
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
Today we have quite a large announcement to make but firstly we here at Excalibur would like to apologise for the lack of updates recently. After a small break over the Christmas and New Year period we are back developing content and updating the game. We have many  updates coming shortly which we believe many of you will enjoy.
First up is a new ship. 
The large ocean cruiser will be one of the largest ships in the game. With a highly detailed Interior and an equally impressive exterior, this gorgeous ship will be the ultimate in luxury to captain.

[img]http://217.174.240.146/ess_announcement_1.jpg[/img]
The ship features port and starboard engines which rotate to steer the boat. It also features a forward engine to help turn the boat when at port.

Second on the list is a new updated UI featuring a mission select screen.

We have made some great changes to the Mission Select screen so you will have access to more information on the mission before starting it. This will include; weather, wind speed and direction, local time, starting area and vessel type.

[img]http://217.174.240.146/ess_announcement_2.jpg[/img]

Finally, we would like to introduce to you our Mission Editor. 
You can use this tool to create and share your own missions. There will be a variety of aspects which you will have control over. These will range from setting the local time and weather to creating waypoints for AI ships to follow.

[img]http://217.174.240.146/ess_announcement_3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://217.174.240.146/ess_announcement_4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE #3 - NEW PORT, NEW MISSION, PREVIEW OF NEW VESSEL
notes.notes:
We have a brand new Early Access Report that you can watch below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tbZih81ZCxM

In summary, we’d like to thank everyone who has been a part of European Ship Simulator and who has left us positive reviews. I’ve personally replied to every review with feedback and offering assistance. I’ll continue to do this throughout the coming months. The best way to help us advance the game and let more people know about the game is to submit us a review, so if you have not done so and want to help spread the word, a review would be greatly appreciated!

Normally we release updates on Fridays, however this week we’re launching it today. You’ll be able to play a mission in the new port of Rostock where you’ll manoeuvre the bulk carrier during snowy conditions. The update is live now and Steam should automatically download the update.

The video above also previews next week’s update, the Speedboat. This is one of those fast vessels that we just enjoy cruising around. It’s great fun exploring the ports in this so we may have some very basic missions next week without time limits so you can play with the speedboat in more detail.

Thanks again everyone for being a part of this, next week will be the last update before the Christmas period as the staff will be away for the holidays. But when we return on the first week of January we will continue with weekly updates.

notes.title: IMPORTANT FIX: Intel/Nvidia Laptop Issue Fixed
notes.notes:
Good news everybody...

We now believe we have solved the issues with the majority of intel/NVidia laptops and have also made steps towards fixing some crashes and perhaps have increased the performance. 

For those who have been experiencing issues, please download the latest version. You may need to restart Steam in order to update the game.

If you do run into any issues, please let us know via the forums or by email

Please make sure you do the following though – 

-	Open the NVidia Control panel (right click on your desktop and select this from the menu)
-	Go to “manage 3D Settings” and then to the “Program Settings” tab
-	Select the ess.exe file from the drop down menu (you may need to add this using the “add” button)
-	In section 2 please select the option “High-performance NVIDIA Processor”

Happy sailing

notes.title: FINAL RELEASE DATE: Pricing For Early Access
notes.notes:
We have some news to share with you all today. We now have a final definite release for European Ship Simulator’s Early Access release. I can assure you that this will not be delayed any further as I know that you have all been incredibly patient.

That release is the 21st of November and the price will be $19.99 (The full game will retail for at least $29.99)… During the first week on Early Access the game will have a 25% discount to reach $14.99. This price of Early Access may raise in the coming months as we add more and more content.

The first version will launch with three ships and three missions. The team are considering adding more missions for launch, but right now we can guarantee three. The ships that you’ll be able to use are the passenger ferry, a bulk carrier and the tugboat.

We have updated the Steam page. This is to alert everyone clearly about the state of Early Access and that there may be issues during the development stage. But we have a system in place to report these issues.

All the best,
Chris
